description: We are Team Alpha 8, a group of developers turning complex NASA data into intuitive exploration tools. By combining deep GIS mapping expertise with creative web development, we are building a bridge between Earth and the stars. Our project transforms raw lunar topography and intimidating celestial physics into beautiful, real-time "Go/No-Go" landing navigators. We believe the journey to a permanent lunar base starts with understanding and we are here to make that data accessible to everyone.
